key_idea: Walk straight until a wall is in front of you, then turn right.
steps: From S Robbie walks right along the top row. He passes B, which is beside him, and stops at the right wall.
He turns right and walks down the right side, passing C. At the bottom he turns right and walks left along the bottom row, passing D.
At the left wall he turns right and walks up, passing E. Then he turns right and walks along the middle row.
He turns right to go down, then right again to walk left, and he reaches A.

choice_feedback.B: Robbie passes B beside him on the top row. It is never in front of him.
choice_feedback.C: Robbie passes C beside him on the way down. It is never in front of him.
choice_feedback.D: Robbie passes D beside him on the bottom row. It is never in front of him.
choice_feedback.E: Robbie passes E beside him on the way up. It is never in front of him.

review.note: Figure check: A is a dead-end square inside the maze, not an opening on the edge, while B, C, D and E are openings on the edge that Robbie walks past. The walk does end at A, but calling A an exit may confuse children. Consider redrawing A as an opening on the outside wall.
